**1) Gauge/thermometer:** Yes — there's a sophisticated horizontal gauge. It's a rounded track with a red-to-white-to-green gradient, tick marks (including a prominent dark center zero line), end labels «لنگ・+100» (green, right) and «شورت・100-» (red, left), and a circular needle marker (green ring with dot) positioned at +40.0% on the green side. A green pill-shaped value bubble «+۴۰٫۰٪» sits above the needle.

**2) Two cards below:** Yes — both "پوزیشن معامله‌گران طلا" (+40.0%) and "پوزیشن خرید معامله‌گران طلا" (51.0%) show horizontal fill bars with tick marks dividing segments, an end-cap dot at the fill edge, values displayed top-left, and caption lines beneath (scale 0–100, weekly changes in red).

**3) Defects:** None apparent. The needle, bubble, labels, and RTL layout are all cleanly aligned; the value bubble slightly overlaps the track area by design, no clipping or misalignment visible.

**Verdict:** Sophisticated — a proper gradient gauge with needle, tick marks, center zero, and labeled ends, plus gradient-filled mini-bars with dots — clearly not a plain simple bar.
